src: Universal Aeronautics and Space Systems in collaboration with Kerbal-Tech(K-Tech) presents the T.R.A.P(Tetrahedral Re-expansion Air Propulsor) Engine, the first in a line of new parts. This engine offers good performance at low altitudes, however, it uses a lot of intake air. At higher altitudes, it offers great performance, at the cost of Liquid Fuel.
zh: Universal Aeronautics and Space Systems 与 Kerbal-Tech(K-Tech) 合作推出 T.R.A.P（四面体再膨胀空气推进器）发动机，是新系列部件中的首款。该发动机在低空性能良好，但进气消耗量大；在高空性能优异，代价是液体燃料消耗较高。
